exposure: Women were divided into two groups based on previous cesarean section with or without trial of labor.
previous cesarean section with or without trial of labor
outcome: duration of first stage of labor
cohort: 657 Chinese women who successfully had a vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC)
finding: Women with a prior cesarean section with a trial of labor experienced faster labor progression after 6 cm of cervical dilation compared to those without a prior trial of labor.
